definition_zh: 游泳；游动；浸在液体中；眩晕
definition_en: to move through water using the body, or to seem to spin around
core_image: 孩子在水面划开双臂，身体贴着水线前进
scene: 夏天他们去河里游泳。In summer they swim in the river.
sceneCN: 这里 swim 是「游泳」（第 1 个义项）；句意：夏天他们去河里游泳。

senses.title: To move through water
senses.definition: to move through water by moving the arms and legs
senses.definitionCN: 靠划动四肢在水中前进
senses.example: In summer they swim in the river.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天他们去河里游泳。
senses.why: This is the physical action the word first named.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最早命名的身体动作。

senses.title: To be covered in liquid
senses.definition: to be covered with or full of liquid
senses.definitionCN: 被液体覆盖或充满
senses.example: The vegetables were swimming in oil.
senses.exampleCN: 蔬菜浸在油里。
senses.why: The image of moving in water is transferred to food sitting in sauce.
senses.whyCN: 在水中移动的画面被移用到泡在汤汁里的食物上。

senses.title: To feel dizzy
senses.definition: to seem to go round and round
senses.definitionCN: 感觉一切在旋转
senses.example: The room began to swim before his eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 房间开始在他眼前旋转。
senses.why: A swimmer loses steady footing, so the word also names the unstable feeling itself.
senses.whyCN: 游泳者失去稳定立足点，于是这个词也用来命名那种不稳的感觉。

senses.title: The activity of swimming
senses.definition: the act or sport of moving through water
senses.definitionCN: 在水中前进的活动或运动
senses.example: She had a long swim before breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 早饭前她游了很久。
senses.why: The verb became a noun for the whole activity, as English often does.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成名词，指整个活动，这在英语里很常见。

definition_zh: 摇摆；摆动；转身；秋千；转变
definition_en: to move back and forth, or a seat hanging on ropes
core_image: 孩子在秋千上前后荡起，绳子划出弧线
scene: 孩子用力荡着秋千。The child pushed the swing high into the air.
sceneCN: 这里 swing 是「秋千」（第 3 个义项）；句意：孩子把秋千推得很高。

senses.title: To move back and forth
senses.definition: to move backwards and forwards from a fixed point
senses.definitionCN: 从固定点来回移动
senses.example: The lamp swung in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 灯在风中摇摆。
senses.why: The hanging seat gave the word its basic picture of motion around a pivot.
senses.whyCN: 悬挂的座位给这个词提供了绕支点运动的基本画面。

senses.title: To turn sharply
senses.definition: to turn quickly in a particular direction
senses.definitionCN: 朝某方向迅速转动
senses.example: She swung round to face him.
senses.exampleCN: 她转身面对他。
senses.why: A swinging object changes direction, so a person turning quickly is described the same way.
senses.whyCN: 摆动的物体改变方向，于是迅速转身的人也用同样的说法。

senses.title: A seat on ropes
senses.definition: a seat hanging from ropes that a person rides for fun
senses.definitionCN: 用绳索吊起供人玩耍的座位
senses.example: The children queued for the swing.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们排队等秋千。
senses.why: The noun names the very object whose motion produced the verb.
senses.whyCN: 名词指的正是产生这个动词的那种物体。

senses.title: A shift in opinion
senses.definition: a change from one position or opinion to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一种立场或观点转向另一种
senses.example: There was a swing towards the opposition.
senses.exampleCN: 出现了倒向反对派的转变。
senses.why: A pendulum moves to the other side, so a change of opinion is pictured as a swing.
senses.whyCN: 钟摆摆向另一边，于是观点的改变被画成一次摆动。

definition_en: a device that turns power on or off, or a change from one thing to another
core_image: 手指按下墙上的开关，房间立刻亮起
scene: 她按下开关，灯亮了。She pressed the switch and the light came on.
sceneCN: 这里 switch 是「开关」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她按下开关，灯亮了。

senses.title: A device for turning power on and off
senses.definition: a small device that starts or stops an electric current
senses.definitionCN: 启动或切断电流的小装置
senses.example: She pressed the switch and the light came on.
senses.exampleCN: 她按下开关，灯亮了。
senses.why: The word first named a thin twig, and a twig flicked to make contact gave the electric device its name.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指细树枝，用树枝轻弹接通电路的装置因此得名。

senses.title: To change to something else
senses.definition: to change from one thing or system to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一种事物或系统改为另一种
senses.example: We switched to a cheaper supplier.
senses.exampleCN: 我们换成了更便宜的供应商。
senses.why: Flicking a switch changes the state at once, so any quick change is called a switch.
senses.whyCN: 拨动开关立刻改变状态，于是任何快速改变都叫 switch。

senses.title: A change or exchange
senses.definition: an act of changing from one thing to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一事物转为另一事物的行为
senses.example: There has been a switch in policy.
senses.exampleCN: 政策出现了转变。
senses.why: The verb became a noun for the change itself, as often happens in English.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成名词指这种改变本身，这在英语里很常见。

senses.title: To exchange one for another
senses.definition: to exchange the positions of two things
senses.definitionCN: 互换两个事物的位置
senses.example: They switched seats before the film.
senses.exampleCN: 电影开场前他们换了座位。
senses.why: Two poles of a switch swap contact, so swapping places is a natural extension.
senses.whyCN: 开关的两极交换接触，因此互换位置是自然引申。

core_image: 广场上白鸽飞起，人们立刻想到和平
scene: 鸽子是和平的象征。The dove is a symbol of peace.
sceneCN: 这里 symbol 是「象征」（第 1 个义项）；句意：鸽子是和平的象征。

senses.title: A sign standing for an idea
senses.definition: a thing that represents a quality or idea
senses.definitionCN: 代表某种品质或观念的事物
senses.example: The dove is a symbol of peace.
senses.exampleCN: 鸽子是和平的象征。
senses.why: The word began with a token broken in two, whose halves proved identity when rejoined.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指一分为二的信物，两半合起便证明身份。

senses.title: A written or printed sign
senses.definition: a mark used to represent something in writing
senses.definitionCN: 书写中用来代表某物的记号
senses.example: The symbol for water is H2O in chemistry.
senses.exampleCN: 化学中水的符号是 H2O。
senses.why: From a physical token, symbol narrowed to a conventional written mark.
senses.whyCN: 从实物的信物，symbol 收窄为约定的书写记号。

senses.title: A person who represents something
senses.definition: a person who stands for a cause or quality
senses.definitionCN: 代表某种事业或品质的人
senses.example: She became a symbol of courage for the town.
senses.exampleCN: 她成了这座小镇勇气的象征。
senses.why: A thing can stand for an idea, and so can a person, which extends the same logic.
senses.whyCN: 物能代表观念，人也能，这沿用了同一个逻辑。

intro.en: Symbol comes from Greek symbolon, a token split between two parties.

items.en: Symbolon was a token broken in two as a pledge.
items.cn: symbolon 是作为信物一分为二的牌子。

items.en: Symbollein meant to throw together, to compare.
items.cn: symbollein 意为把东西放一起、作比较。

items.en: Latin symbolus named a sign or mark.
items.cn: 拉丁语 symbolus 指记号或标志。

items.en: French symbole carried the sign sense into English.
items.cn: 法语 symbole 把记号之义带入英语。

items.en: Symbol widened to objects and people representing ideas.
items.cn: symbol 扩展到代表观念的事物与人。

note.en: Symbol is compared with look-alike words and with other signs.
note.cn: 把 symbol 与形近词以及其他表示符号的词作比较。

definition_en: the feeling of being sorry for someone who is suffering
core_image: 一束白花放在门口，卡片上只写着一句节哀
scene: 她对他的失去深表同情。She felt great sympathy for his loss.
sceneCN: 这里 sympathy 是「同情」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她对他的失去深表同情。

senses.title: Feeling sorry for another
senses.definition: the feeling of pity for someone in trouble
senses.definitionCN: 对困境中人的怜惜之情
senses.example: She felt great sympathy for his loss.
senses.exampleCN: 她对他的失去深表同情。
senses.why: The Greek source means shared feeling, so the noun names the emotion felt alongside another.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语源头意为共同的感受，因此这个名词指与他人一同产生的情绪。

senses.title: The ability to feel for others
senses.definition: the capacity to understand another s suffering
senses.definitionCN: 理解他人痛苦的能力
senses.example: He has no sympathy for lazy excuses.
senses.exampleCN: 他对懒惰的借口毫无同情心。
senses.why: A single feeling became a lasting quality of character.
senses.whyCN: 一次的感受变成持久的品格。

senses.title: An expression of comfort
senses.definition: words or gifts offering comfort
senses.definitionCN: 表示安慰的话语或礼物
senses.example: They sent a letter of sympathy to the family.
senses.exampleCN: 他们给那家人寄去慰问信。
senses.why: Feeling must be expressed, so the noun also names the message that carries it.
senses.whyCN: 感受需要表达，因此这个名词也指承载它的讯息。

senses.title: Agreement with a cause
senses.definition: support for an idea or group
senses.definitionCN: 对某个主张或群体的支持
senses.example: The workers acted in sympathy with the strike.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们声援这场罢工。
senses.why: Sharing feeling slides into sharing a purpose, which yields the sense of support.
senses.whyCN: 共感滑向共同的目标，于是产生支持之义。

intro.en: Sympathy comes from Greek sympatheia, feeling together.
intro.cn: sympathy 源自希腊语 sympatheia，意为共同感受。

items.en: Sympatheia named a shared condition or feeling.
items.cn: sympatheia 指共同的处境或感受。

items.en: Pathos meant what is felt or endured.

items.en: Late Latin sympathia kept the shared feeling sense.

items.en: Sympathy first described harmony between bodies.

items.en: Sympathy settled on pity for another s trouble.

definition_en: a set of connected parts or rules working together
core_image: 地铁线路图上纵横交错的彩色线条汇成一个网络
scene: 这座城市的地铁系统非常方便。The city s metro system is very convenient.
sceneCN: 这里 system 是「系统」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这座城市的地铁系统非常方便。

senses.title: Connected parts working together
senses.definition: a group of parts that operate as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体运作的一组部件
senses.example: The city s metro system is very convenient.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的地铁系统非常方便。
senses.why: The Greek word meant an organized whole, which is exactly the modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个希腊词意为有组织的整体，正是现代的含义。

senses.title: An established set of rules
senses.definition: an organized set of rules or customs
senses.definitionCN: 一套有组织的规则或惯例
senses.example: The tax system favours small firms.
senses.exampleCN: 税制对小企业有利。
senses.why: Rules arranged into a working whole are a system in the same sense as machinery.
senses.whyCN: 规则被安排成运作的整体，与机械系统同理。

senses.title: An organized method
senses.definition: a planned way of doing something
senses.definitionCN: 有计划的行事方式
senses.example: She has a system for taking notes.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一套记笔记的方法。
senses.why: A personal routine can also be an organized whole, so the word covers method.
senses.whyCN: 个人习惯也能构成有组织的整体，因此这个词也指方法。

senses.title: The body as a whole
senses.definition: the body or one of its functional groups
senses.definitionCN: 身体或其中某个功能组
senses.example: Exercise strengthens the immune system.
senses.exampleCN: 锻炼增强免疫系统。
senses.why: The body is the most literal set of connected parts, so its groups are also systems.
senses.whyCN: 身体是最字面的相连部件集合，因此其各类功能组也叫系统。

intro.en: System comes from Greek systema, an organized whole.
intro.cn: system 源自希腊语 systema，意为有组织的整体。

items.en: Systema meant a whole put together from parts.
items.cn: systema 意为由部分组成整体。

items.en: Synistanai meant to set up together.
items.cn: synistanai 意为一起建立。

items.en: Late Latin systema named an arranged whole.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 systema 指安排好的整体。

items.en: French systeme carried the ordered sense to English.
items.cn: 法语 systeme 把有序整体的含义带入英语。

items.en: System extended to rules, methods and the body.

definition_zh: 桌子；表格；一桌人；提交（议案）
definition_en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs, or an arranged set of facts
core_image: 木桌中央摆着茶壶，四条桌腿稳稳压住地板
scene: 晚饭已经摆在桌上了。Dinner is already on the table.
sceneCN: 这里 table 是「桌子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：晚饭已经摆在桌上了。

senses.title: A piece of furniture
senses.definition: furniture with a flat top and legs
senses.definitionCN: 有平面与支腿的家具
senses.example: Dinner is already on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭已经摆在桌上了。
senses.why: The Latin word tabula named a flat board, which is exactly the object we still call a table.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tabula 指平板，正是我们今天仍称作桌子的物件。

senses.title: Facts set out in rows
senses.definition: facts arranged in rows and columns
senses.definitionCN: 按行列排列的事实
senses.example: The results are shown in the table below.
senses.exampleCN: 结果见下表。
senses.why: A flat board is where figures were laid out, so an arranged set of facts kept the same name.
senses.whyCN: 平板是摆放数字的地方，因此按规则排列的事实沿用了同一个名字。

senses.title: The people seated together
senses.definition: a group of people sitting at one table
senses.definitionCN: 围坐一桌的一群人
senses.example: The whole table laughed at the story.
senses.exampleCN: 一桌人都被这个故事逗笑了。
senses.why: The furniture stands for the group gathered around it, a common kind of transfer.
senses.whyCN: 家具代指围坐其旁的人群，这是常见的转喻。

senses.title: To present formally
senses.definition: to propose something for discussion
senses.definitionCN: 正式提出供讨论
senses.example: They tabled a motion at the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在会上提交了一项动议。
senses.why: A document placed on the table is offered to the assembly, so the noun became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 把文件放到桌上就是提交给会议，于是名词转为动词。

definition_en: to deal with a difficult problem, or to grab and stop an opponent in sport
core_image: 水手把缠成一团的绳索一根根理顺
scene: 甲板上的绳索缠成一团，水手们开始动手处理。The sailors began to tackle the ropes tangled on deck.
sceneCN: 这里 tackle 是「处理、对付」（第 1 个义项）；句意：水手们开始处理甲板上缠成一团的绳索。

senses.title: To deal with a problem
senses.definition: to make a determined effort to deal with something difficult
senses.definitionCN: 下决心应对困难的事情
senses.example: We must tackle the problem before it grows.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须在问题变大之前处理它。
senses.why: Gear was sorted and set in order before work began, so the verb came to mean setting to work.
senses.whyCN: 先把索具整理归位，再开工；于是这个词从「整理装备」引申为「着手处理」。

senses.title: To grab an opponent
senses.definition: to stop a player by taking hold of them and pulling them down
senses.definitionCN: 抓住对方球员并把他摔倒以阻止进攻
senses.example: The defender tackled the runner at the line.
senses.exampleCN: 防守队员在线上擒抱了跑卫。
senses.why: The physical grip on gear became a physical grip on a rival.
senses.whyCN: 对装备的用力抓握，转成了对对手的用力抓握。

senses.title: Equipment for a sport
senses.definition: the set of equipment used for an activity such as fishing
senses.definitionCN: 某项活动所用的成套装备，如钓具
senses.example: He packed his fishing tackle into the car.
senses.exampleCN: 他把钓具装进车里。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the gear itself.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「装备」本身，动词义由整理装备的动作发展而来。

note.en: Tackle is compared with look-alike words and with verbs for handling difficulties.

definition_en: the part that sticks out at the back of an animal or object, or to follow someone secretly
core_image: 小狗摇着翘起的尾巴迎接主人
scene: 小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。The little dog wagged its tail as soon as its owner came home.
sceneCN: 这里 tail 是「尾巴」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。

senses.title: The back part of an animal
senses.definition: the long part that grows from the back of an animal
senses.definitionCN: 动物身体后部长出的部分
senses.example: The little dog wagged its tail as soon as its owner came home.
senses.exampleCN: 小狗一见主人回家，立刻摇起尾巴。
senses.why: The core sense is the moving appendage at the back.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项就是身体后部会摆动的那一条。

senses.title: The rear end of anything
senses.definition: the last or back part of an object, line, or period
senses.definitionCN: 物体、队伍或时段的最后部分
senses.example: The plane lifted its tail first.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机先抬起机尾。
senses.why: Anything with a front can be imagined with a tail at the back.
senses.whyCN: 凡有前端之物，都可以想象出一条位于后端的「尾巴」。

senses.title: To follow someone secretly
senses.definition: to follow a person quietly in order to watch where they go
senses.definitionCN: 悄悄跟在某人后面，看他去哪里
senses.example: A stranger tailed him through the market.
senses.exampleCN: 一个陌生人在市场里尾随他。
senses.why: To follow at the tail is to stay just behind like a tail.
senses.whyCN: 跟在「尾巴」的位置上，就是像尾巴一样紧贴身后。

definition_en: to get hold of something and carry it, to need time, or to choose a way of acting
core_image: 伸手抓起桌上的钥匙
scene: 地铁进站时，他抓起背包冲上车。When the train arrived, he took his bag and jumped on.
sceneCN: 这里 take 是「拿起、抓起」（第 1 个义项）；句意：地铁进站时，他抓起背包冲上车。

senses.title: To get hold of something
senses.definition: to put your hand on something and hold it
senses.definitionCN: 把手放在某物上并握住它
senses.example: He took the keys from the table.
senses.exampleCN: 他从桌上拿起钥匙。
senses.why: The core act is the hand closing on an object.
senses.whyCN: 核心动作就是手掌合拢抓住一件东西。

senses.title: To carry or bring
senses.definition: to carry something or someone to another place
senses.definitionCN: 把某物或某人带到另一个地方
senses.example: Please take this letter to the office.
senses.exampleCN: 请把这封信带到办公室。
senses.why: What is grasped is then carried away.
senses.whyCN: 抓住之后自然就是带走，于是长出「携带」义。

senses.title: To need time
senses.definition: to require a certain amount of time or effort
senses.definitionCN: 需要一定的时间或精力
senses.example: The journey takes two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这段路程要花两个小时。
senses.why: Time is pictured as something the task takes into its hand.
senses.whyCN: 时间被想象成任务伸手拿走的资源，因此 take 表示花费时间。

senses.title: To choose or accept
senses.definition: to choose a way of acting or to accept an offer
senses.definitionCN: 选择某种做法或接受某个提议
senses.example: She took the job in the end.
senses.exampleCN: 她最后接受了这份工作。
senses.why: Taking an option is mentally grasping it.
senses.whyCN: 把某个选项「抓到手里」，就是采取或接受它。

sensesIntro.en: Take starts from grasping and branches into carrying, spending time, and choosing.
sensesIntro.cn: take 从抓取出发，分叉出携带、耗费时间与做出选择。

core.cn: 核心意象：手合拢抓住物体并把它提起。

branches.en: Grasping is the starting point.
branches.cn: 抓取是全部义项的起点。

branches.en: Carrying follows grasping.

branches.en: Time is taken like an object.

branches.en: An option is grasped mentally.
branches.cn: 选项是在心里被抓住的。

branches.en: Hand and journey join in one verb.
branches.cn: 手与行程在同一个动词里汇合。

definition_en: a story, especially one that may not be true or is told in an imaginative way
core_image: 炉火边讲述的漫长故事：真假难辨，却让人一直听下去
scene: 祖父在冬夜里讲起年轻时航海遇险的经历，孩子们听得入了迷。The old sailor told a long tale about his voyage across the stormy sea.
sceneCN: 这里 tale 是「故事、叙述」（第 1 个义项：一段讲述出来的故事）；句意是老水手讲述了一段关于自己跨越风暴之海的漫长故事。

derivatives.zh: story（故事）+ teller（讲述者），义为「讲故事的人」
tale + telling（讲述），义为「讲故事；搬弄是非」

senses.title: A story that someone tells
senses.definition: a story that someone tells, often one that is imaginative or entertaining
senses.definitionCN: 某人讲述的一段故事，常带有想象色彩或趣味性
senses.example: Grandmother told us a tale about a clever fox.
senses.exampleCN: 祖母给我们讲了一只聪明狐狸的故事。
senses.why: The core image is someone narrating by the fire: words flow forward and carry listeners into another world.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是有人在炉边开口叙述：话语向前流淌，把听众带进另一个世界，所以最基本义就是「讲出来的故事」。

senses.title: An account of events, real or invented
senses.definition: an account of a series of events, whether true or invented
senses.definitionCN: 对一连串事件的记述，可以是真实的也可以是虚构的
senses.example: The survivor gave a moving tale of the shipwreck.
senses.exampleCN: 幸存者讲述了感人的沉船经历。
senses.why: A narration may carry real experience; the same flowing words can recount actual events, extending the story sense to personal accounts.
senses.whyCN: 叙述既可以承载虚构，也可以承载真实经历：同一股「流淌的话语」被用来记述事件，于是故事义延伸为「经历、记述」。

senses.title: A lie or an unreliable report
senses.definition: a statement or report that is not true or cannot be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 不真实或不可信的说法、传闻
senses.example: Don't believe that tale; it is just gossip.
senses.exampleCN: 别信那种说法，那只是谣言。
senses.why: Because many fireside stories are invented, the word picked up a hint of fabrication, giving the negative sense of untrustworthy talk.
senses.whyCN: 因为炉边故事常是编出来的，这个词沾上了「虚构」的意味，于是引申出「不实之词、谣言」的贬义。

senses.title: A full reveal of past behavior
senses.definition: the whole story that past marks or evidence reveal about someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 痕迹或证据所揭示出的全部情况
senses.example: The worn boots told their own tale of hard travel.
senses.exampleCN: 磨破的靴子诉说着艰苦旅行的经历。
senses.why: Traces speak like a narrator: marks on an object reveal the past just as words tell a story, so evidence itself becomes a tale.
senses.whyCN: 痕迹会像叙述者一样「开口」：物品上的印记揭示过去，正如话语讲述故事，因此证据本身也成了一种「故事」。

senses.title: A traditional legend passed down
senses.titleCN: 传说；口口相传的古老故事
senses.definition: an old story about past people or events that is passed down by word of mouth
senses.definitionCN: 关于过去人物或事件、经口耳相传保留下来的古老故事
senses.example: The village keeps an ancient tale of a hidden treasure.
senses.exampleCN: 村子保留着一个关于宝藏的古老传说。
senses.why: Fireside narration repeats across generations; when the same story travels through many mouths, it hardens into legend.
senses.whyCN: 炉边叙述代代重复：当同一个故事经过无数张嘴流传下来，它就凝固成了「传说」。

senses.title: A long, tedious amount of talk or writing
senses.definition: a long and often boring piece of speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 冗长且常令人生厌的一大段话语或文字
senses.example: He launched into a long tale about his troubles.
senses.exampleCN: 他开始絮絮叨叨地大讲自己的麻烦。
senses.why: The flowing narration can go on and on; when words keep flowing without end, the story becomes tedious length.
senses.whyCN: 叙述可以不断向前流淌：当话语流个不停、没有尽头时，「故事」就变成了「冗长的讲述」。

senses.title: A tale as a literary genre
senses.definition: a work of fiction, especially a short narrative in literary form
senses.definitionCN: 一种叙事性文学作品，尤指短篇故事
senses.example: The book contains six tales of the Middle Ages.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书收录了六个中世纪故事。
senses.why: Spoken stories were later written down and shaped into art; the narration itself became a named literary genre.
senses.whyCN: 口头故事后来被写定并打磨成艺术：叙述本身成为一种有名字的文学体裁，即「故事体作品」。

senses.title: Dead men tell no tales as a saying
senses.titleCN: 谚语用法：死人不会泄密
senses.definition: used in the saying that dead people cannot reveal secrets
senses.definitionCN: 用于谚语，指死去的人不会泄露秘密
senses.example: They silenced the witness, saying dead men tell no tales.
senses.exampleCN: 他们让证人闭了嘴，说死人不会泄密。
senses.why: A tale can reveal what someone knows; when the narrator is gone, the flow of words stops, so secrets stay buried.
senses.whyCN: 故事能泄露讲述者所知的事：叙述者一旦不在，话语之流便停止，秘密也就被埋葬。

intro.en: Tale comes from Old English, sharing a deep root with the verb tell, and its history runs through Germanic storytelling traditions.
intro.cn: tale 源自古英语，与动词 tell 同出一个深层词根，其历史贯穿日耳曼的口述传统。

items.en: The root is generally reconstructed as *talō in Proto-Germanic, connected with counting and speaking, from the idea of counting out words.
items.cn: 该词根一般重构为原始日耳曼语 *talō，与「数、说」相关，来自「数出话语」的观念。

items.en: Old English talu meant tale, speech, and also counting; the same root gave the verb tell, which once meant both to count and to narrate.
items.cn: 古英语 talu 意为故事、言语，也指计数；同一词根派生出动词 tell，后者一度兼指「数数」与「讲述」。

items.en: In Middle English the spelling tale settled, and the counting sense separated into the word tale replaced by number talk and new borrowings.
items.cn: 中古英语时期拼写定型为 tale，「计数」义逐渐分离，讲述义成为主导。

items.en: Chaucer's Canterbury Tales fixed the word as the standard term for a told narrative in English literary tradition.
items.cn: 乔叟的《坎特伯雷故事集》使 tale 成为英语文学传统中「讲述的叙事」的标准用词。

items.en: Today tale suggests an old-fashioned or imaginative story, often with a hint that it may not be fully true.
items.cn: 现代英语中 tale 多指老式或富于想象的故事，常带「未必全真」的意味。

note.en: Tale is easily confused with similar-looking nouns and with near-meaning story words.
note.cn: tale 容易与拼写相近的名词以及近义的故事类词汇混淆。

entries.definitionCN: 搬弄是非的人，由 tale 加 bearer 构成

entries.definition: a general word for an account of events, true or fictional
entries.definitionCN: 泛指故事、叙述，真实虚构皆可，是最通用的说法

entries.definitionCN: 以动物为主角、寓意道德教训的寓言

normalIntro.cn: 利用词根关联和常见搭配来记忆 tale。

normal.en: Tale shares its root with tell: what you tell becomes a tale.
normal.cn: tale 与 tell 同根：你 tell（讲述）出来的内容就是 tale（故事）。

normal.en: Fairy tale is one of the most common phrases: a fairy tale is an imaginative story.
normal.cn: 常见短语 fairy tale（童话）：充满想象的故事就是 tale。

normal.en: The Canterbury Tales is the classic English work; great tales survive for centuries.
normal.cn: 《坎特伯雷故事集》是英国文学经典：伟大的 tale 能流传数百年。

normal.en: An old wives' tale means an unscientific belief: not every tale is true.
normal.cn: old wives' tale（无稽之谈）：并非所有 tale 都可信。

normal.en: A storyteller is one who tells tales; the -tale root appears in narrative contexts.
normal.cn: storyteller（讲故事的人）：与 tale 同族的叙述类词汇常成对出现。

abstract.en: Picture a fireside circle where one long tale winds through the winter night.
abstract.cn: 想象炉火围坐的一圈人，一个长长的 tale 蜿蜒穿过冬夜。

abstract.en: Feel the thread of words flowing from the speaker's mouth, knotting into a story.

abstract.en: See worn boots on a shelf silently telling their own tale of the road.

examples.en: Grandfather's tales always began with the words: a long time ago.
examples.cn: 祖父的故事总是以「很久以前」开头。

sensesIntro.en: Tale moves from a told story outward to real accounts, gossip, revealed evidence, legend, and literary form.
sensesIntro.cn: tale 从「讲述的故事」出发，延伸到真实经历、不实之言、证据所揭示的底细、传说与文学体裁。

core.cn: 核心意象：话语从讲述者口中流出，在炉边蜿蜒成篇

branches.cn: 讲述的故事，先在口头流传，后来成为文学体裁

definition_en: a natural ability to do something well, or people who have such ability
core_image: 天平一端称出沉甸甸的分量
scene: 教练一眼就看出这个少年身上有天赋。The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.
sceneCN: 这里 talent 是「天赋、才能」（第 1 个义项）；句意：教练一眼就看出这个少年身上有天赋。

senses.title: A natural ability
senses.definition: a natural ability to do something well
senses.definitionCN: 把某件事做好的天生能力
senses.example: The coach saw at once that the boy had talent.
senses.exampleCN: 教练一眼就看出这个少年有天赋。
senses.why: A talent was once a weighed amount of metal, so ability was pictured as something measured out.
senses.whyCN: talent 原指称量出的一笔金属，于是才能被想象成天生「分到」的分量。

senses.title: People with ability
senses.definition: people who are good at something, considered as a group
senses.definitionCN: 被作为一个群体看待的有才干的人
senses.example: The company is looking for young talent.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司在寻找年轻人才。
senses.why: The ability was transferred to the people who carry it.
senses.whyCN: 「才能」这一抽象物被转移到拥有它的人身上。

intro.en: Talent began as a unit of weight and value before it meant a gift.
intro.cn: talent 最初是重量与价值的单位，后来才表示天赋。

items.en: Talanton meant a balance and a weighed sum.
items.cn: talanton 意为天平与称出的数额。

items.en: Talentum kept the sense of a weight of money.
items.cn: talentum 保留了「一笔重量的钱」之义。

items.en: Talenta appeared in biblical parables of entrusted money.
items.cn: talenta 出现在受托钱财的圣经比喻中。

items.en: Talent came to mean a God-given ability.
items.cn: talent 转而表示上天赋予的能力。

items.en: It now means natural ability and able people.
items.cn: 现代英语中指天赋与有才能的人。

note.en: Talent is compared with look-alike forms and with words for ability.
note.cn: 把 talent 与形近形式以及表示能力的词作对比。

normal.en: The boy had talent for music.

examples.en: The company is looking for young talent.

examples.en: Natural talent still needs daily practice.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太能」——「太能」干的人，就是身上有天赋的人。

root: 希腊语 talanton（天平、称出的重量）经拉丁语 talentum 进入英语，由「一笔钱财」转为「天赋」。

sensesIntro.en: From a weighed sum of money, talent moved to an inborn ability and then to able people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从称出的一笔钱，talent 转向天生的能力，再转向有才能的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pair of scales weighing out a share.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架天平称出一份分量。

branches.en: Ability inherits the image of a measured share.
branches.cn: 才能继承了「分得的一份」这一形象。

branches.en: The gift stands for the gifted.
branches.cn: 「天赋」转指拥有天赋的人。

branches.en: One word holds both the gift and its bearers.

branches.en: A pool of talent is a pool of people.
branches.cn: 人才储备就是一群人的储备。

intro.en: Talent has a tight family of adjectives and a vivid root history.
intro.cn: talent 有一个紧凑的形容词词族和生动的词根史。

latinIntro.en: Latin talentum, from Greek talanton, means a balance and a weighed sum.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 talentum（源自希腊语 talanton）意为天平与称出的数额。

definition_en: to speak to someone, or a conversation or a speech on a subject

scene: 两个老朋友在街角站着聊了很久。The two old friends stood at the corner and talked for a long time.
sceneCN: 这里 talk 是「交谈、说话」（第 1 个义项）；句意：两个老朋友在街角站着聊了很久。

senses.title: To speak with someone
senses.definition: to speak to another person in an informal way
senses.definitionCN: 以轻松的方式对另一个人说话
senses.example: The two old friends talked for a long time.
senses.exampleCN: 两个老朋友聊了很久。

senses.whyCN: 这个词与 tale、tell 同族，核心是人与人之间交换话语。

senses.title: A lecture on a subject

senses.why: A talk is one voice speaking at length to many.
senses.whyCN: talk 也指一个声音对着许多人长时间讲述。

senses.title: Formal discussions
senses.definition: official discussions between groups or governments
senses.definitionCN: 团体或政府之间的正式商谈
senses.example: The two sides held talks in the capital.
senses.exampleCN: 双方在首都举行了会谈。
senses.why: Conversation becomes diplomacy when it is formal and repeated.
senses.whyCN: 谈话一旦正式并且反复进行，就成了外交层面的「会谈」。

normalIntro.cn: talk 属于 tale 与 tell 的词族，话语在人与人之间传递。

normal.en: The two old friends talked for a long time.
normal.cn: 两个老朋友聊了很久。

normal.en: She gave a talk on climate change.
normal.cn: 她作了一场关于气候变化的讲座。

normal.en: The two sides held talks in the capital.
normal.cn: 双方在首都举行了会谈。

normal.en: Let us talk it over before deciding.
normal.cn: 决定之前我们再商量一下。

normal.en: He is a quiet man who rarely talks.
normal.cn: 他话少，很少交谈。

abstract.en: Talk is a bridge built from words.
abstract.cn: 交谈是用话语搭起的桥。

abstract.en: One voice to many becomes a lecture.
abstract.cn: 一个声音对着众人，就成了讲座。

abstract.en: Repeated talk hardens into negotiation.
abstract.cn: 反复的谈话会固化成谈判。

examples.en: The two old friends stood at the corner and talked for a long time.
examples.cn: 两个老朋友在街角站着聊了很久。

examples.en: She gave a talk on climate change.
examples.cn: 她作了一场关于气候变化的讲座。

examples.en: The two sides held talks in the capital.
examples.cn: 双方在首都举行了会谈。

root: 中古英语 talken 与 tale（故事）、tell（讲述）同源，核心是「用话语叙述」。

sensesIntro.en: Talk runs from private conversation to public lecture to official negotiation.
sensesIntro.cn: talk 从私下交谈，延伸到公开讲座与正式谈判。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people trading words at a corner.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人在街角交换话语。

branches.en: Conversation is the everyday branch.
branches.cn: 交谈是最日常的分支。

branches.en: A lecture is talk before an audience.
branches.cn: 讲座是对听众的谈话。

branches.en: Official talk becomes negotiation.
branches.cn: 正式谈话变成谈判。

branches.en: Both are voices exchanging meaning.
branches.cn: 两者都是交换意义的声音。

branches.en: Public and formal speech share a stage.
branches.cn: 公开与正式言说共享同一个舞台。

intro.en: Talk extends through -er, -ative, and compounds.
intro.cn: talk 通过 -er、-ative 与复合词扩展。

latinIntro.en: Talk is Germanic; Latin loqui, to speak, is a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: talk 属日耳曼语；拉丁语 loqui（说话）是语义对应词。

definition_zh: 高的；高大的；难以置信的
definition_en: having a greater height than usual, or hard to believe
core_image: 篮球场上最高的少年伸手够到篮筐
scene: 球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。The tallest boy on the court reached the basket without jumping.
sceneCN: 这里 tall 是「高的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。

senses.title: Of great height
senses.definition: having a greater height than is usual for a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 高度超过一般人、一般物的
senses.example: The tallest boy on the court reached the basket without jumping.
senses.exampleCN: 球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。
senses.why: The older sense was brave and fine, and height came to stand for that dignity.
senses.whyCN: 较早的义项是「勇敢、出色」，身材的高大便成了这种气度的象征。

senses.title: Hard to believe
senses.definition: difficult to believe because it is exaggerated
senses.definitionCN: 因为夸张而难以让人相信的
senses.example: He told a tall story about catching a fish as big as a boat.
senses.exampleCN: 他讲了一个荒诞的故事，说他钓到一条船那么大的鱼。
senses.why: A tall tale is a story that stands too high to be true.
senses.whyCN: 「高得离谱的故事」即高到不可能是真的，于是 tall 表示夸张、难信。

intro.en: Tall first meant swift and brave, and only later meant high.
intro.cn: tall 最初意为敏捷、勇敢，后来才表示高。

items.en: Getæl meant swift and ready.
items.cn: getæl 意为敏捷、利落。

items.en: Tall meant brave, fine, and handsome.
items.cn: tall 意为勇敢、出色、俊美。

items.en: Tall shifted to the sense of height.
items.cn: tall 转向表示身高。

items.en: Tall spread to buildings and trees.
items.cn: tall 扩展到建筑与树木。

items.en: A tall story means an exaggerated one.
items.cn: tall story 指夸张难信的故事。

note.en: Tall is compared with look-alike words and with adjectives of height.
note.cn: 把 tall 与形近词以及表示高度的形容词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Tall once praised a brave person, then came to praise a tall body.
normalIntro.cn: tall 曾用来称赞勇敢的人，后来转去形容高大的身材。

normal.en: The tallest boy reached the basket easily.
normal.cn: 最高的男孩轻松够到篮筐。

normal.en: That tall building blocks the sun.
normal.cn: 那座高楼挡住了阳光。

normal.en: He likes to tell tall stories.
normal.cn: 他喜欢讲荒诞的故事。

normal.en: Stand tall when you face a crowd.
normal.cn: 面对人群时要昂首挺立。

normal.en: The tree is taller than the wall.
normal.cn: 这棵树比墙还高。

abstract.en: Height was once a picture of courage.
abstract.cn: 高度一度是勇气的图像。

abstract.en: A story too tall to stand is hard to believe.
abstract.cn: 高得立不住的故事自然难以相信。

abstract.en: Tall measures the body and the tale.
abstract.cn: tall 既量身材，也量故事。

examples.en: The tallest boy on the court reached the basket without jumping.
examples.cn: 球场上最高的男孩不用跳就够到了篮筐。

examples.en: He told a tall story about catching a fish as big as a boat.
examples.cn: 他讲了一个荒诞的故事，说他钓到一条船那么大的鱼。

examples.en: Stand tall when you face a crowd.
examples.cn: 面对人群时要昂首挺立。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「托高」——把他「托高」一点，人就显得高大了。

root: 古英语 getæl（敏捷、利落）经中古英语 tall（勇敢、俊美）转为表示身高。

sensesIntro.en: Tall moved from praise of a brave person to physical height, then to exaggerated stories.
sensesIntro.cn: tall 从称赞勇敢的人，转到身体高度，再转到夸张的故事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure standing above the crowd.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个高出人群的身影。

branches.en: Height is the modern everyday sense.
branches.cn: 高度是今天的日常义项。

branches.en: An exaggerated story stands too high.
branches.cn: 夸张的故事「立得太高」。

branches.en: Both use height as a measure.
branches.cn: 两者都以高度为尺度。

branches.en: Standing tall is both body and pride.
branches.cn: 昂首挺立既是身体也是尊严。

branches.en: A tall tale stretches the truth upward.
branches.cn: 荒诞故事把真相往上拉长。

intro.en: Tall is a short adjective with a surprising history.
intro.cn: tall 是个短小的形容词，却有一段出人意料的历史。

latinIntro.en: Tall is native Germanic; Latin altus, high, is its semantic counterpart.
latinIntro.cn: tall 是本土日耳曼词；拉丁语 altus（高）是它的语义对应词。

definition_en: a large container for liquid or gas, an armoured military vehicle, or to fail badly
core_image: 院子里盛满雨水的大铁箱
scene: 院子里的水箱在烈日下被晒得发烫。The water tank in the yard grew hot under the burning sun.
sceneCN: 这里 tank 是「水箱、罐」（第 1 个义项）；句意：院子里的水箱在烈日下被晒得发烫。

senses.title: A large container
senses.definition: a large container used for holding liquid or gas
senses.definitionCN: 用来盛装液体或气体的大容器
senses.example: The water tank in the yard grew hot under the burning sun.
senses.exampleCN: 院子里的水箱在烈日下被晒得发烫。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a pool or stored water, from which any large container grew.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是水池、蓄水处，各种大容器都由此而来。

senses.title: An armoured vehicle
senses.definition: a heavy military vehicle with armour and a gun
senses.definitionCN: 带装甲和火炮的重型军用车辆
senses.example: The old tank stands in the museum yard.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆旧坦克停在博物馆的院子里。
senses.why: The vehicle was disguised as a water tank when it was first shipped.
senses.whyCN: 这种车辆首次运输时被伪装成「水箱」，名字就此留下。

senses.title: To fail badly
senses.definition: to do very badly or lose heavily
senses.definitionCN: 表现糟糕或大比分落败
senses.example: The film tanked at the box office.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影票房惨败。
senses.why: A tank that empties runs dry, and a failing effort is pictured the same way.
senses.whyCN: 水箱见底就是「空了」，失败的努力被想象成同样的干涸。

intro.en: Tank first meant a pool of water; the military sense is a modern code name.
intro.cn: tank 最初指水池，军事义来自现代的一个代号。

items.en: Portuguese tanque meant a pool, perhaps from an Indian source.
items.cn: 葡萄牙语 tanque 意为水池，可能源自印度语言。

items.en: Tank named a large container of water.
items.cn: tank 指盛水的大容器。

items.en: The first armoured vehicles were shipped as water tanks.
items.cn: 最早的装甲车以「水箱」的名义运输。

items.en: The name tank stuck to the vehicle.
items.cn: 坦克这个名字就留在了这种车辆上。

items.en: The verb came to mean failing badly.
items.cn: 动词义发展为惨败。

note.en: Tank is compared with look-alike words and with words for containers and vehicles.
note.cn: 把 tank 与形近词以及表示容器和车辆的词作对比。

normal.en: The water tank is full again.

normal.en: The old tank stands in the museum yard.

normal.en: The film tanked at the box office.

normal.en: The fish tank glows at night.

abstract.en: A container and a weapon share one name.
abstract.cn: 容器与武器共用一个名字。

abstract.en: The tank that empties is a failed effort.
abstract.cn: 空了的水箱就是失败的努力。

abstract.en: A disguise became a permanent label.
abstract.cn: 一次伪装变成了永久的名称。

examples.en: The water tank in the yard grew hot under the burning sun.
examples.cn: 院子里的水箱在烈日下被晒得发烫。

examples.en: The old tank stands in the museum yard.
examples.cn: 那辆旧坦克停在博物馆的院子里。

examples.en: The film tanked at the box office.
examples.cn: 这部电影票房惨败。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「坦克」——音译词，铁皮大箱子既装水，也装火炮。

root: 可能经葡萄牙语 tanque（水池）进入英语，更早来源不确定；军事义源自把装甲车称为「水箱」的代号。

sensesIntro.en: Tank moves from a water pool to any large container, to an armoured vehicle, to total failure.
sensesIntro.cn: tank 从水池，到大容器，到装甲车，再到彻底失败。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a large iron box holding water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只盛水的大铁箱。

branches.en: The container is the base sense.
branches.cn: 容器是基础义项。

branches.en: The vehicle hid under the container name.
branches.cn: 车辆藏在容器的名称之下。

branches.en: Running dry pictures failure.
branches.cn: 见底干涸比喻失败。

branches.en: Full and empty tell the story.
branches.cn: 满与空讲完了整个故事。

branches.en: Steel and water share one word.
branches.cn: 钢铁与水共用一个词。

intro.en: Tank extends through -er and -ful and many compounds.
intro.cn: tank 通过 -er、-ful 以及大量复合词扩展。

latinIntro.en: Tank likely reached English through Portuguese, not Latin, so the Latin list stays short.
latinIntro.cn: tank 很可能经葡萄牙语进入英语，而非拉丁语，因此拉丁同源词较少。

definition_zh: 轻敲；轻拍；水龙头；开发；利用
definition_en: to hit something lightly, a device controlling water flow, or to make use of a resource
core_image: 指尖在桌面上轻轻敲三下
scene: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗，提醒他绿灯亮了。Someone tapped gently on the car window to remind him the light was green.
sceneCN: 这里 tap 是「轻敲」（第 1 个义项）；句意：有人轻轻敲了敲车窗，提醒他绿灯亮了。

senses.title: To hit lightly
senses.definition: to strike something gently with the fingers or a small object
senses.definitionCN: 用手指或小物件轻轻击打
senses.example: Someone tapped gently on the car window.
senses.exampleCN: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗。
senses.why: The sound of a light blow is the oldest core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 轻击发出的声音是这个词最古老的内核。

senses.title: A device for running water
senses.definition: a device that controls the flow of water from a pipe
senses.definitionCN: 控制管道中水流大小的装置
senses.example: The tap in the kitchen kept dripping all night.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房的水龙头整夜滴水。
senses.why: A faucet was once a plug struck or turned to release water.
senses.whyCN: 水龙头最初就是被敲开或拧开的塞子，动作延伸成了器具。

senses.title: To make use of a resource
senses.definition: to make use of something that is available
senses.definitionCN: 把已有的资源拿出来使用
senses.example: The company tapped into a young market.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司开发了一个年轻的市场。
senses.why: Opening a tap lets stored water flow, just as a resource is opened for use.
senses.whyCN: 打开龙头让存水流出，正如把资源打开来使用。

intro.en: Tap began as the sound and act of a light blow, then named a water outlet.
intro.cn: tap 最初是轻击的声音与动作，后来指水的出口。

items.en: Tappen meant to strike lightly.
items.cn: tappen 意为轻敲。

items.en: Tap named the strike and its sound.
items.cn: tap 指轻击及其声音。

items.en: A tap became a spout for water.
items.cn: tap 又指放水的龙头。

items.en: Tapping a line meant listening secretly.
items.cn: 在线上「搭一下」就是秘密窃听。

items.en: To tap a resource is to open it for use.
items.cn: 开发资源就是把它打开使用。

note.en: Tap is compared with look-alike words and with words for knocking and faucets.
note.cn: 把 tap 与形近词以及表示敲击和水龙头的词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Tap is a small sound, a small turn of a handle, and a resource let loose.
normalIntro.cn: tap 是轻轻一声、轻轻一拧，也是让资源流出来。

normal.en: Someone tapped gently on the car window.
normal.cn: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗。

normal.en: The kitchen tap kept dripping.
normal.cn: 厨房水龙头一直在滴水。

normal.en: The company tapped into a young market.
normal.cn: 这家公司开发了一个年轻的市场。

normal.en: He tapped the keys twice.
normal.cn: 他轻敲了两下键盘。

normal.en: Tap water is safe to drink here.
normal.cn: 这里的自来水可以直接喝。

abstract.en: A light touch opens a heavy flow.
abstract.cn: 轻轻一触，放出滔滔水流。

abstract.en: Tapping is asking for attention in sound.
abstract.cn: 轻敲是用声音请求注意。

abstract.en: Every resource waits behind a tap.
abstract.cn: 每份资源都等在某个龙头后面。

examples.en: Someone tapped gently on the car window to remind him the light was green.
examples.cn: 有人轻轻敲了敲车窗，提醒他绿灯亮了。

examples.en: The tap in the kitchen kept dripping all night.
examples.cn: 厨房的水龙头整夜滴水。

examples.en: The company tapped into a young market.
examples.cn: 这家公司开发了一个年轻的市场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踏普」——脚尖「踏」着地打拍子，一下一下，就是轻敲。

root: 中古英语 tappen（轻击），拟声来源；由轻击动作引申出水龙头与「开发资源」。

sensesIntro.en: Tap grows from a light blow to a water outlet to the opening of any resource.
sensesIntro.cn: tap 从轻击长出水龙头，又长出「打开资源」的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fingertips striking a surface three times.
core.cn: 核心意象：指尖在表面上敲三下。

branches.en: The light blow is the source sense.
branches.cn: 轻击是源义项。

branches.en: The outlet releases what is stored.
branches.cn: 龙头释放储存之物。

branches.en: Resources flow like water.
branches.cn: 资源像水一样流出。

branches.en: Both are about opening a flow.
branches.cn: 两者都关于打开流动。

branches.en: Even a phone tap begins with a light touch.
branches.cn: 连电话窃听也始于轻轻一接。

intro.en: Tap builds a small family of agents and actions.
intro.cn: tap 构成由施动者与动作组成的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Tap is likely imitative in origin; Latin tangere, to touch, is only a semantic echo.
latinIntro.cn: tap 很可能是拟声词；拉丁语 tangere（触碰）只是语义回声。

definition_zh: 胶带；磁带；用胶带粘；录制
definition_en: a long thin strip that sticks, a magnetic strip for sound, or to record something
core_image: 一条透明胶带贴在纸箱接缝上
scene: 她用胶带把纸箱的接缝封好。She sealed the seam of the box with tape.
sceneCN: 这里 tape 是「胶带」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她用胶带把纸箱的接缝封好。

senses.title: A sticky strip
senses.definition: a long narrow strip with glue on one side
senses.definitionCN: 一面涂有黏胶的细长条
senses.example: She sealed the seam of the box with tape.
senses.exampleCN: 她用胶带把纸箱的接缝封好。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a narrow woven strip, which later carried glue.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是窄窄的织带，后来这种带上涂了胶。

senses.title: A magnetic recording strip
senses.definition: a long plastic strip coated to store sound or images
senses.definitionCN: 涂有磁性材料、可存储声音或影像的长条
senses.example: The old tape still plays in his car.
senses.exampleCN: 那盘旧磁带还能在他的车里播放。
senses.why: A thin strip became the carrier of recorded sound.
senses.whyCN: 细长的带子变成录制声音的载体。

senses.title: To stick with tape
senses.definition: to fix something in place with sticky tape
senses.definitionCN: 用黏胶带把东西固定住
senses.example: He taped the note to the door.
senses.exampleCN: 他用胶带把便条贴在门上。
senses.why: The noun turned into the act of applying it.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接转化为「贴上胶带」的动作。

senses.title: To record sound or pictures
senses.definition: to record something on tape or a digital medium
senses.definitionCN: 把声音或画面录制下来
senses.example: They taped the interview for the radio.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为电台录制了这次采访。
senses.why: Recording put sound onto the moving strip, so the strip gave its name to the act.
senses.whyCN: 录制是把声音存到移动的带子上，于是带名成了动作名。

intro.en: Tape first meant a narrow woven band, long before glue or music.
intro.cn: tape 最初指窄织带，远早于胶与录音。

items.en: Tæppe meant a narrow strip of cloth.
items.cn: tæppe 意为窄布带。

items.en: Tape kept the sense of a thin band.
items.cn: tape 保留了细带之义。

items.en: Adhesive tape gave the strip a new use.
items.cn: 黏胶带赋予这种带子新用途。

items.en: Magnetic tape carried recorded sound.
items.cn: 磁带承载录制的声音。

items.en: The verb means to stick or to record.
items.cn: 动词义为粘贴或录制。

note.en: Tape is compared with look-alike words and with words for strips and recordings.
note.cn: 把 tape 与形近词以及表示带子与录音的词作对比。

normalIntro.en: Tape is a narrow band that has held cloth, glue, and sound.
normalIntro.cn: tape 是一条窄带，先后承载布料、胶与声音。

normal.en: She sealed the box with tape.
normal.cn: 她用胶带封好箱子。

normal.en: The old tape still plays in his car.
normal.cn: 那盘旧磁带还能在他车里播放。

normal.en: He taped the note to the door.
normal.cn: 他用胶带把便条贴在门上。

normal.en: They taped the interview for radio.
normal.cn: 他们为电台录制了采访。

normal.en: Too much red tape slows the work.
normal.cn: 太多繁文缛节拖慢了工作。

abstract.en: One thin strip can join, store, and repeat.
abstract.cn: 一条细带能粘合、储存、重放。

abstract.en: Glue and music share the same band.
abstract.cn: 胶与音乐共用同一条带。

abstract.en: What is taped can be kept against time.
abstract.cn: 被录下的东西能对抗时间。

examples.en: She sealed the seam of the box with tape.
examples.cn: 她用胶带把纸箱的接缝封好。

examples.en: The old tape still plays in his car.
examples.cn: 那盘旧磁带还能在他的车里播放。

examples.en: They taped the interview for the radio.
examples.cn: 他们为电台录制了这次采访。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贴普」——「贴」在箱子上的那条带子，就是 tape。

root: 古英语 tæppe（窄布带），由「细长条」发展为胶带、磁带，并引申出粘贴与录制。

sensesIntro.en: Tape runs from a woven band to an adhesive strip to a magnetic carrier and its verbs.
sensesIntro.cn: tape 从织带，到胶带，到磁性载体，再到相应的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow band running along a surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条沿着表面延伸的窄带。

branches.en: The sticky strip is the daily sense.
branches.cn: 黏胶带是日常义项。

branches.en: The same strip stores sound.
branches.cn: 同一种带子储存声音。

branches.en: The verb means applying the strip.
branches.cn: 动词指贴上这条带。

branches.en: Recording borrows the strip name.
branches.cn: 录制借用了带子的名字。

branches.en: Tape and taping are one story.
branches.cn: 磁带与录制是同一个故事。

intro.en: Tape extends through compounds and simple inflection.
intro.cn: tape 通过复合词与简单屈折扩展。

latinIntro.en: Tape is native Germanic; Latin taenia, a band, is a distant parallel.
latinIntro.cn: tape 是本土日耳曼词；拉丁语 taenia（带子）是远房对应词。

items.example: The tape is on the desk.

items.exampleCN: 录音室现在不用磁带了。

definition_en: an object aimed at, a goal, or to make something the aim of an action
core_image: 箭簇正插在靶心的红圈里
scene: 第一支箭就射中了靶子的中心。The first arrow hit the centre of the target.
sceneCN: 这里 target 是「靶子」（第 1 个义项）；句意：第一支箭就射中了靶子的中心。

senses.title: A mark to shoot at
senses.definition: a board or object marked with rings for shooting at
senses.definitionCN: 画有圆环、供射击的板或物
senses.example: The first arrow hit the centre of the target.
senses.exampleCN: 第一支箭就射中了靶子的中心。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the small round shield used for practice.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是练习用的小圆盾，靶子由此而来。

senses.title: A goal to reach
senses.definition: a result that a person or group aims to achieve
senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体想要达到的结果
senses.example: The team met its sales target this year.
senses.exampleCN: 团队今年完成了销售目标。
senses.why: A goal is a target you shoot at with effort rather than an arrow.
senses.whyCN: 目标就是你用努力而非箭去射的那个靶。

senses.title: To aim at something
senses.definition: to direct an action or effort toward a particular group or thing
senses.definitionCN: 把行动或精力对准某个群体或事物
senses.example: The campaign targets young voters.
senses.exampleCN: 这场活动针对年轻选民。
senses.why: The noun turned into the act of aiming.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成了「瞄准」这个动作。

intro.en: Target came from a small shield carried in practice.
intro.cn: target 源自练习时用的那种小圆盾。

items.en: Targette was a small shield.
items.cn: targette 意为小盾。

items.en: Target named a light round shield.
items.cn: target 指轻便的圆盾。

items.en: Target became the mark for shooting.
items.cn: target 变成射击的靶子。

items.en: It extended to goals in business and study.
items.cn: 它扩展到商业与学业中的目标。

items.en: The verb means aiming effort at something.
items.cn: 动词义为把精力对准某物。

note.en: Target is compared with look-alike forms and with words for goals.
note.cn: 把 target 与形近形式以及表示目标的词作对比。

entries.definition: an aim or a scoring point

normalIntro.en: Target is a shield turned into a mark, then into a goal.
normalIntro.cn: target 是由盾牌变成的靶，再由靶变成目标。

normal.en: The arrow hit the centre of the target.
normal.cn: 箭射中靶心。

normal.en: The team met its sales target.
normal.cn: 团队完成了销售目标。

normal.en: The campaign targets young voters.
normal.cn: 这场活动针对年轻选民。

normal.en: The shot was on target.
normal.cn: 这一枪正中目标。

normal.en: A moving target is hard to hit.
normal.cn: 移动的靶子很难击中。

abstract.en: A shield in practice becomes a goal in life.
abstract.cn: 练习场上的盾，成了人生里的目标。

abstract.en: Aim turns an object into a purpose.
abstract.cn: 瞄准把一个物件变成一种目的。

abstract.en: Every target is a promise of direction.
abstract.cn: 每个目标都是一份方向的承诺。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「他个头」——瞄准「他个头」那么高的小圆牌，就是靶子。

root: 古法语 targette（小盾），进入英语后由「练习用盾」转为「靶子」，再引申为「目标」。

sensesIntro.en: Target moves from a practice shield to a shooting mark to any goal and the act of aiming.
sensesIntro.cn: target 从练习用盾，到射击靶，再到任何目标与瞄准的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow standing in a red centre.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支箭钉在红色靶心上。

branches.en: The shooting mark is the base sense.
branches.cn: 射击靶是基础义项。

branches.en: A goal is a target for effort.
branches.cn: 目标是努力的靶。

branches.en: The verb is the act of aiming.
branches.cn: 动词是瞄准的动作。

branches.en: Both are things aimed at.
branches.cn: 两者都是被瞄准之物。

branches.en: Planning and aiming belong together.
branches.cn: 规划与瞄准本是一体。

intro.en: Target forms a modern family of aiming words.
intro.cn: target 形成一组关于瞄准的现代词族。

latinIntro.en: Target comes from Old French, ultimately from a shield word.
latinIntro.cn: target 来自古法语，根源是表示盾的词。
